description.zh:
权限组规则描述。

长度不超过32个字符。
description.en:
Description of the permission group rule.

The length cannot exceed 32 characters.

description.zh:
权限组规则优先级。

取值范围：1~100，其中1为最高优先级。
description.en:
Priority of the permission group rule.

Valid values: 1 to 100, where 1 is the highest priority.

description.zh:
授权对象对文件系统的读写权限。

取值：

- RDWR：可读可写
- RDONLY：只读
description.en:
Read and write permissions of the authorization object on the file system.

Valid values:

- RDWR: read-write
- RDONLY: read-only

descriptions.zh: VPC默认权限组（DefaultAccessGroupName）中的规则不支持修改。
descriptions.en: Rules in the VPC default permission group (DefaultAccessGroupName) cannot be modified.
